mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes ground-level ozone in the context of summer air pollution?
options: It is a secondary pollutant formed when NOx and VOCs react in sunlight.
It is a primary pollutant formed directly from dust storms.
It is formed when PM10 reacts with fog in the absence of sunlight.
It is produced when stubble burning reacts with cold, stagnant air.
mcqs.explanation: Ground-level ozone is a secondary pollutant formed when NOx and VOCs react in sunlight. The tempting dust-storm option is incorrect because dust is associated with PM10, whereas ozone formation requires NOx, VOCs and sunlight.
